title: My classroom
intro: Create a classroom, invite your learners, and see how they are getting on. You see their progress, their figures and their answers — never their photos.

create.firstIntro: Name it, and you can hand out your first invitation on the next screen. Nothing else is needed.
create.nameHint: Whatever you call the group — "Tuesday club" or "Year 9 set 2". Only you and your learners see it.
create.archivedNote: An archived classroom is out of the way, not gone. Your learners keep their accounts, their projects and their answers, and you can bring it back at any time.

invite.heading: Invite a learner
invite.intro: Choose a username for her. She will use it to sign in, and she chooses her own password when she redeems the code — you never see it.
invite.usernameHint: 3 to 24 characters: letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores. It has to be unused across the whole lab, so something like "maria-t9" works better than "maria".
invite.shownOnce: This is the only time you will see the code. Only a scrambled version is stored, so it cannot be looked up again — copy it now.
invite.expiry: It works for {{hours}} hours and can only be used once.
invite.inPerson: Hand it over in person or write it down. The lab holds no email address for a learner and never sends her anything.

failure.usernameTaken: That username already belongs to an account. Choose another one.
failure.invitationExists: There is already an unused invitation for that username. Revoke it below, then make a new one.
failure.usernameShape: A username needs 3 to 24 characters, and only letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.
failure.notYourClassroom: That classroom is not yours, or it is archived.
failure.unconfigured: This copy of the lab has no account service set up, so invitations cannot be made.
failure.unknown: That did not work. Nothing was created — try again.

roster.heading: Learners ({{count}})
roster.empty: Nobody has joined yet. Make an invitation above and hand it over.

pending.heading: Invitations
pending.caption: Usernames appear here only until they are redeemed. After that a learner is shown by the name she chose.

detail.noImages: Her photos are not here and cannot be. They stay in the browser on her own device, and this screen has no way to reach them.
detail.noProgress: She has not started a module yet.
detail.noRuns: She has not trained a model yet.
detail.bestAccuracy: Best so far: {{accuracy}}% across {{runs}} training runs.
detail.noReflections: She has not answered a reflection question yet.
detail.resetNote: She enters this on the "set a new password" screen and chooses a new password herself. Her name and all her work stay as they are.
detail.removeBody: You will stop seeing her progress and her answers. She keeps her account, her projects and everything she has written — this only ends your view of her.
detail.deleteBody: This removes her account and everything the lab has stored for her: her progress, her figures and every answer she wrote. It cannot be undone.
detail.deleteLocalNote: It does not touch the photos and trained models on her own device — the lab cannot reach those from here. Tell her they are still hers to keep or delete.

export.note: The export covers this classroom only. Learners appear by the name they chose, never by username, and it contains no photos. Any answer starting with =, +, - or @ gets a quote mark in front of it, so your spreadsheet shows it as text instead of running it as a formula.
